versions.content: Name Bmc_AtomicSType Kind Type Derived from sint 5 15 of 31 Document ID 946: AUTOSAR_SWS_BSWMulticoreLibrary Specification of Basic Software Multicore Library AUTOSAR CP R22-11 4 Range -  The Bmc_AtomicSType shall always be mapped to a platform specific type where atomic operations can be realized by the respective HW platform, to ensure that all the operations performed on this type are lock-free Description The type shall be used for all signed data items, which are used for Bmc library functions. Available via Bmc.h
